72. Answer: B
Level: easy
Explanation: + Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) was founded on 16 October 1945 in
Quebec City.
It is a specialized agency of the United Nations that works to eliminate hunger, improve
nutrition, and promote sustainable agriculture.

16 October is observed every year as World Food Day to mark the FAO's founding.

74, Answer: C
Level: easy
Explanation: * The Mahanadi Water Disputes Tribunal was constituted by the Government of
India in 2018 under the Inter-State River Water Disputes Act, 1956.
It was established to adjudicate the water-sharing dispute between Odisha and Chhattisgarh

over the Mahanadi River.

75. Answer: C
Level: easy
Explanation: * Hirakud Dam is built across the Mahanadi River near Sambalpur.
It is located in the state of Odisha
It is one of the longest earthen dams in the world and is used for flood control, irrigation, and

hydroelectric power generation.

76. Answer: B
Level:easy
Explanation: ° Article 262 of the Constitution of India empowers Parliament to:
o Provide for the adjudication of disputes relating to inter-State river waters.
o Exclude the jurisdiction of the Supreme Court and other courts over such disputes by law.
This provision led to the enactment of the Inter-State River Water Disputes Act, 1956.
